## Problem Sets

Problem sets are distributed as `.qmd` files along with their rendered `.html` form. You should edit the provided `.qmd` file and render to `.html` when submitting the assignment. Additional files (e.g. datasets) are located in sub-folders. For convenience, all the combined files are also distributed as a `.zip` compressed archive.

Links become active when each assignment is released.

- [Github Repository](https://github.com/astrezhnev/ps818/tree/main/psets/ps1)

## Exams

The take-home midterm and final exams have the same format and structure as the problem sets, with one key difference: you are **not** permitted to collaborate with other students or any other individual on the exams. Clarifying questions will be answered on the discussion board, but substantive questions will not.
